description: Capability for the main window and every per-table HUD overlay window
comment: 'overlay*' is a glob, and it has to be. Overlay windows are created
at runtime, one per tracked PokerStars table, with labels overlay1,
overlay2, ... — none of which an explicit list could name in advance.
This file previously listed exactly ['main', 'overlay'], and the failure
that caused is worth recording because nothing catches it: Tauri's ACL
gates *plugin* commands, not the app's own #[tauri::command] functions.
So a window outside this list could still invoke every Velora command and
render a full HUD, while 'plugin:event|listen' was denied — silently, into
a .catch(). Every overlay looked correct on open and then never updated
again: no refresh on a new hand, no visibility or mode broadcast, no
shared seat template. Found by dealing a hand to a simulated table and
